FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
ADVERTISEMENT
Imphal, the llb December, 2024
No. HCM/D-42/2023-Estt.-1/28870 : Applications are invited frOm
willing and eligible candidates for the translation of judgments of the Hon’ble Supreme
Court of India and Hon'ble High Court of Manipur from English to Manipuri (Roman
alphabet) on a Work from Home basis
1. Work Description: The empanelled translators will be engaged strictly on
Project Basis under the AI-Assisted Legal Advisory Committee of the High Court
of Manipur to translate the reportable judgments of the Hon’ble Supreme Court
of India and Hon’ble High Court of Manipur from English to Manipuri (Roman
alphabet) .
2. Educational Qualifications and other requirements:
> Candidates should possess a Bachelor’s or Master's degree and should have
proficiency in both English and Manipuri.
> Proficiency in Computer Applications is mandatory.
> Preference will be given to candidates holding a law degree with prior
translation experience.
3. Remuneration: Empanelled translators will receive remuneration at a rate of
Rs. 200 per page (based on the number of pages in the original English
judgments as uploaded on the official website of the Honl>Ie Supreme Court of
India and Hon’ble High Court of Manipur).
4. Age Limit: There is no age limitation.
5. Opening date of online registration: 18.12.2024 (11:00 A.M.).
6. How to Register:
P' Go to the "Registration for the various posts under the Project of
the AI-Assisted Legal Translation Advisory Committee" section on
the website of the High Court of Manipur (www.hcmimpF'!a!,nic.in)
Click on the post you want to register for i.e. TRANSLATOR
(CANDIDATES MUST USE THEIR VALID PERSONAL E-MAIL ID &
PHONE NUMBER)
Upload a scanned copy of your recent photograph and fill up in all the
necessary details in the online registration form.
Click on the "SUBMIT" button .
P
r
7. No Objection Certificate:
Applicants who are currently employed under any Government organizations
must submit a No Objection Certificate from the concerned Authorities and a
copy of the same should be submitted at the time of Personal Interaction.
Page 1 of 2
8. Mode of Selection:
r A Written Test, where candidates will translate a few paragraphs from a
judgment of the Hon’ble Supreme Court/High Court into Manipuri (Roman
alphabet), and
Shortlisted candidates will be called for Personal Interaction.r
Note:-
•
Al-Assisted Legal Translation Committee reserves the right to select and/or
empanel individuals as Translators.
•
The empanelment of Translators will be strictly performance-based, with
continued inclusion contingent on meeting the required standards. Failure to
adhere to these standards may result in de-empanelment at any stage of the
project.
Online registration deadline: Applications will remain open throughout the9.
project duration. Eligible candidates may apply anytime, and selection tests i.e.,
Written Test and Personal Interaction (at SI. No. 8 above) will be conducted on
a first-come, first-serve basis based on the requirements.
